title: The Teeth of the Savannah
desc: Explore the African wilderness and learn about the various species that live there.

title: A Game Of Leopard Thrones
desc: Filmed over ten years, an in-depth look at the leopard characters of South Africa and their fascinating unfolding story once their Queen dies.

title: Wolves & Lions: Old Enemies
desc: Felines and canids clash across the world. Dive into direct battles and strategies to steal food. Intelligence and strength decide who reigns in each territory.

title: Big Cats: An Amazing Animal Family
desc: Patrick Aryee comes within a whisker of some of Earth's most majestic predators as he embarks on a remarkable journey through the feline family tree.

title: Brotherhood of Lions
desc: The young males of the lion pride must form a coalition to work together against their rivals, but they first need to leave their mothers at two years old and fend for themselves.

title: Wild Sky
desc: Experiencing the powerful phenomena roaming the skies above North America.

title: Animal Attack Rate
desc: The filmmakers shed light on a variety of dangerous wild animals in Africa, including big cats that hunt zebras, buffaloes and even humans.

title: Leopard Dynasty: The Rise of Rana
desc: In India's Jhalana Reserve, strength, strategy and survival collide in a wild power struggle.

title: March of the Elephants
desc: Presenting a herd's 18-month journey across 808 miles in Yunnan, China. Locals assist and guide the elephants through various environments.

title: River Monsters
desc: Jeremy Wade is on a mission to track down the famous Loch Ness monster. The journey takes him from the depths of the famous Scottish loch to the volcanoes of Iceland.

title: Tiger On The Run
desc: Follow a young tiger in India that has been forced out of its home territory by another male and has to struggle for survival.

title: Elephants Up Close
desc: African elephants are sensitive, helpful and gentle. They are the largest land mammals on Earth and most of them are found in Botswana, where they rule the savannah with their intelligence.
